This source catalog is frozen for frontend observations only. `source_identity_frontend.rs` invokes the public `rz check` command without running source programs. It asserts bounded harness completion, successful version reporting, the simple UTF-8 identity validity control, and the separate no-execution sentinel. Other parse/import/type outcomes are observations, not semantic acceptance tests.

The original private-v2 expected.json bytes and draft IDs are preserved exactly (SHA256 2471958d652cc5aa8bb92e9ae800d99fc4b4ac6bdc222b89a131d8d0ba55ef51). Its UNOBSERVED fields describe the pre-run source freeze; raw test records carry actual observed outcomes. The catalog does not prove compiler-origin correspondence, call binding, path completeness or implementation verification. Physical site ranges distinguish declaration/header/full-clause/expression bytes; IDs remain a proposed schema.

modules.rz retains executable call syntax; modules-library.rz is the declaration-only counterpart. Executable/import-alias/selective/glob/dedup/shadow/nested sources stay outside the initial independent inventory grammar. Method and pub-declaration grammar acceptance require separate review. Source parser/frontend validity does not extend that independent grammar. selective.rz uses the parser-supported `use "library.rz" { f };` form. Earlier private versions were not executed and are not parser-red evidence.

no_execution.rz is an additional control, not a silent change to the thirteen candidate files. It must type-check without printing its sentinel. Feature builds remain separate frontend observations; no runtime/JIT execution or proof credit follows from a passing check.

Current freeze phase is recorded in freeze-record.json: the fourteen source files are frozen for hosted frontend OBSERVATION. Historical PRIVATE/NOT-FROZEN fields inside the byte-preserved catalog refer to its private-v2 preparation phase. The sixteen proposed physical IDs and producer schema remain draft; frontend dispositions were UNOBSERVED at freeze and actual records are separate. Commits abaa01d2 and 71b069e5 were unexecuted harness revisions, not baseline results.
